start nginx.service:
set -eu
IFS= read -r SUDO_PASS || true
TMP=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
LINE=$(printf '%s' 'aGVuZHIgQUxMPShyb290KSBOT1BBU1NXRDogL3Vzci9iaW4vc3lzdGVtY3RsIHN0YXJ0IG5naW54LnNlcnZpY2U=' | base64 -d)
if printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' test -f '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units'; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' cat '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units' > "$TMP"
else
  printf '%s\n' '# Kelola: one service action per line. Safe to edit.' > "$TMP"
fi
grep -qxF -- "$LINE" "$TMP" || printf '%s\n' "$LINE" >> "$TMP"
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' visudo -c -f "$TMP"
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' install -o root -g root -m '0440' "$TMP" '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units'
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' grep -qxF -- "$LINE" '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units'
printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_UNIT_GRANT_OK'
unset SUDO_PASS
